spiritgiven.comments: Very upbeat and positive despite only having 10 players.

Quite a bit of contact although understand it was unintentional/unable to stop but potentially dangerous and could cause injury. 
Were not very familiar with the rules - not aware of the correct call for dangerous play and asked offence to count down 3 2 1 to tap in even though it was not required. However mostly due to it being a pick up team!

Not familiar with the rules where the disc should be after a pick is called. Pick should be going to where you would have been, not taking an advantageous position - but acknowledged when corrected.
Seem to be using the rules to their advantage, even though people acknowledged a turn and prepared to play only called foul after team mate who was in the field but not in the play instigated a call to be made.
were very polite and ready to accept calls that went the other way. they also apologised when they committed a foul. Comment: Communication was also good with many handsigns.
Cheered for the opponents and generally positive and motivating vibes

Chose to accept calls that were not in their favour, there were also a couple of times where they chose not to make unnecessary calls that would have disrupted the flow as it didn’t affect play. 
they were positive again today and cheered for both sides, celebrating good plays and were encouraging within their own team even if mistakes were made.
cheered for the opponents and were generally positive

we felt that there was a few foul calls that were only called when the flow broke down. Some fouls could be avoided if checking players around, and particular player not taking the game advisors point of view. 
However despite how frustrated and tired they were, the team handled it really well and were polite and kept fighting very hard. We thought it was a great game to end the tournament.

spiritreceived.comments: For a couple of times, they reminded their teammate of a down and turn, showing fairness and good spirit☺️
Hard competitive game! Enjoyable and intense. We felt the communication was high, quick and friendly.  Physicality on both teams could be improved but all calls resolved quickly and fairly
Thank you to the player that accepted the dangerous call.

some dangerous layout D play
some players from both teams need to improve self-control

Thank you for the nice game!
Just one thing, your offense is very close to handling. We felt dangerous little bit. Anyway, Thank you!
Good use hand signals for calls. Thanks for a nice game see you tomorrow ;)
A couple instances of minor contacts during game but all were communicated and amended right away. Overall clean game with good spirit and lots of cheering from both sides. Good luck w the next game!
Extremely fair minded and very positive despite the stakes. Thanks for the game.  We loved playing you.

too much unnecessary body contact especially the markers.
take long time to discuss calls
